decisions.reason: The semi-transparent bouclé-effect fabric builds directly on the firm's decoration know-how, but it has only low website visibility and the similar wool bouclé leno was already withdrawn, so pruning risk is rising as the 2023 collection ages.

Flame-retardant jacquard curtains use the firm's functional-fabric expertise for contract and hospitality projects, where its own R&D lets it interpret and improve results, and the product's dedicated page signals ongoing commitment.

The double-face wool-blend extends existing capabilities and uses renewable fibre, but its low visibility and the firm's push to cut hard-to-recycle blends leave it vulnerable at the next collection rotation.
The braided-structure fabric was launched only in 2024 with its own page, and it draws on the firm's upholstery and curtain knowledge, so it is too early to judge and worth continued learning.
